Scream Tail

Fairy Psychic

Paldea · Generation 9

Scream Tail is a Fairy/Psychic-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 8 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is HP (115), with a base stat total of 570.
